entries.19acbe4c329342ff: Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥11,690 million, down 18.8% year on year. By business, the foundation business accounted for ¥11,492 million and the real estate leasing business for ¥198 million. The main causes of the revenue decline were a drop in demand and intensified competition in its core markets of Kanto and Shizuoka Prefecture, together with significant delays in the start of construction work.

entries.a10090c7da42dd8b: This business manufactures and sells concrete piles, purchases and sells building materials, and undertakes contracts for various construction works incidental to concrete secondary products. Consolidated subsidiary TA Pile Seizō Co., Ltd. handles product shipment and on-site work, and Tōshō Co., Ltd. handles the purchase of raw materials such as cement materials and joint fittings.
